description: Once a case is trimmed to a single outcome (fz-sc8.44), it no longer branches, but its arms are still separate pieces. Native turns each piece into its own function, so a case that decides nothing still costs a resume entry or two (the join walk's resume-entry pin stays 38). Expected: lowering merges a piece with its only successor, and the resume-entry count falls. This belongs to lowering, not type analysis.
title: A case that decides nothing costs no resume entry
